title: Simply Pumpkin Pancakes
description: These light and fluffy pumpkin pancakes are quick and easy to make for a delicious fall breakfast full of pumpkin flavor. Serve warm with syrup.

steps.text: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, and nutmeg together in a large bowl.

Whisk milk, pumpkin, egg, and oil together in a separate bowl until smooth. Gently stir milk mixture into the flour mixture until just combined; add more milk, 1 tablespoon at a time, if the batter is too thick. Batter should be thick but pourable and slightly lumpy.

Heat a lightly oiled griddle over medium-high heat to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Drop batter by large spoonfuls onto the griddle and cook until bubbles form and the edges are dry, 1 to 3 minutes. Flip and cook until browned on the other side, about 1 minute more. Repeat with remaining batter.
Serve pancakes warm with butter and maple syrup.

video.description: In this video, we'll show you how to make pancakes that get a fall weather makeover with the flavors of pumpkin spice. A basic pancake batter gets an addition of cinnamon, nutmeg, and pumpkin puree. Drop the batter onto a hot griddle and cook for a few minutes. Slather in butter and syrup as usual, or try drizzling cream cheese icing and sprinkling some chopped pecans to the top.
